_comment: Custom Lithum egg for Pelican and Pterodactyl panels. Import through the panel administrator, then upload the Linux x86_64 executable to the server root.
name: Lithum
author: Lithum contributors
description: Lithum Rust Minecraft server for Linux x86_64. Upload lithum-server-linux-x86_64 to the server root after installation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo 'Lithum egg installed. Upload lithum-server-linux-x86_64 to the server root before starting.'
